const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => /Allow in this chat/.test(b.textContent)); if (!b) return 'NO CONSENT CARD'; b.click(); return 'allowed: ' + [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(x => /Always allow|Don.t allow/.test(x.textContent)).length + ' other choices were offered'

const s = window.__ensemble.getState(); const k = Object.keys(s.items).find(k => s.items[k].some(i => i.kind === 'screen')); const steps = (s.items[k] || []).filter(i => i.kind === 'screen').map(i => i.action + ':' + i.status + (i.shot ? '+shot' : '') + ' [' + i.label + ']'); return 'steps: ' + steps.join(' | ') + ' || screens: ' + JSON.stringify(Object.values(s.screens).map(x => [x.kind, x.active, x.width + 'x' + x.height])) + ' || computer setting: ' + s.settings.computer

const s = window.__ensemble.getState(); const k = Object.keys(s.screens).find(k => k.endsWith(':desktop')); const acc = k.split(':')[1]; const steps = s.items[s.chatId + ':' + acc].filter(i => i.kind === 'screen'); s.setLive({ key: k, step: steps[1].id })
